style.a: Idempotency means that sending the same request many times produces the same final state as sending it once, regardless of intermediate changes. It is useful for retries: a client can repeat a request without creating duplicate records, and the server can safely ignore redundant work. It does not mean the request is free of side effects, and it does not apply to every HTTP method.

Python threads share the interpreter and its global state, so they cannot run independent Python code on different cores: the GIL serializes bytecode execution. Multiprocessing spawns separate processes, each with its own interpreter and memory space, so CPU-bound work can use multiple cores. The trade-off is interprocess communication and serialization overhead, plus fork-related complications on some platforms. For I/O-bound work, threads or asyncio are often preferable.

Un load balancer distribuisce le richieste in ingresso tra più istanze di servizio per evitare che una sola sia sovraccarica. Può scegliere il prossimo target in modo round-robin, in base al carico corrente o in base al risultato di una health check, e può anche fare failover quando un nodo è down. Il load balancing non sostituisce la replica: serve a sfruttare più risorse, mentre la replica serve a duplicare lo stato per la disponibilità.
